upstreamCommitNote: The 4.2.0 npm tarball records gitHead 83810982, which is not published on GitHub and has no v4.2.0 tag; its index.js and LICENSE are byte-identical to upstream commit f01112e9 ("Declare types", 2025-03-19), the last commit before the 2025-05-09 publish. Only package.json metadata differs.
rationale: Temporary security build for GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp (CVE-2026-93748: request max-stale serves shared-cache entries whose maxAge() was zeroed for reuse restrictions, e.g. another user's Set-Cookie) and GHSA-f27v-pv5m-c5g6 (CVE-2026-93750: Vary wildcard in non-canonical form and prototype field names match), both against <= 4.2.0 with no fixed release. GHSA-f27v was still unreviewed (not in npm audit) at import time; it is fixed here because this build sorts above 4.2.0 and would otherwise hide it. Reached only by the build toolchain (got/cacheable-request, make-fetch-happen), not by the packaged app.
removalCriteria: Remove after upstream publishes a release that fixes GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp and GHSA-f27v-pv5m-c5g6 and the advisories list it as patched, with npm audit remaining at zero. If an advisory range becomes < 4.2.1, npm audit (which compares prereleases) reports 4.2.1-nexus.1 on purpose, forcing the switch.

files.changeSummary: Two Nexus security patches. (1) GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp: adds _requiresRevalidation(), mirroring exactly the reuse restrictions that zero maxAge() (not storable, no-cache, shared Set-Cookie without public/immutable, Vary: *, shared proxy-revalidate), and evaluateRequest() returns a miss for such responses right after the must-revalidate check, so request max-stale can no longer serve them. (2) GHSA-f27v-pv5m-c5g6: _varyMatches() takes the logic of upstream commit 9fb520be (a * member anywhere in Vary never matches; field names never match through Object.prototype), re-indented to the file style. No other byte changes.

secondaryProvenance.changeSummary: Logic of the merged (unreleased) _varyMatches fix for CVE-2026-93750, ported without behavior changes; the upstream commit also de-indents the method, which is not reproduced.

files.changeSummary: Exact byte-for-byte copy from the http-cache-semantics 4.2.0 npm tarball.
